name: CopenOpen Poetry Slam
description:
CopenOpen is an open poetry slam that you can attend as a guest or slammer every third Friday of the month. It costs DKK 50 to see the performers, and tickets can be purchased at the door.

If you want to participate as a slammer, please note the following:

  • You can ONLY register for the next poetry slam. You do this by sending a private message to CopenOpen on our Facebook page from the 1st of each month. Places are allocated on a first-come, first-served basis.
    The rules for the slam are:
  • Ten slammers in the first round and six in the second round. Points from the two rounds are added together, and the three with the most points go to the final, where the points are reset.
  • You must have written your own text.
  • You may not use costumes, props, or musical instruments.
  • The audience awards points between 0 and 10. The slammers may not know the judges.
  • If you perform for more than 3 minutes and 10 seconds, you will be given a time penalty: ½ point for every 10 seconds or part thereof.
  • Freestylers get an extra minute to collect words from the audience (this must be reported to the host before the show starts).
  • All participants get two beer tickets.
  • The order is drawn by lot before the show starts. Therefore, slammers must be present 15 minutes before the show starts.

And remember - the point is not the points, the point is the poetry.

(NOTE: The primary language of the event is Danish).

name: The Orgelheimers' Sing Along Christmas Songbook
description:
Disclaimer: DETTE ER IKKE EN NORMAL ORGELHEIMERS KONCERT. BANDET SPILLER UDELUKKENDE JULESANGE
The Orgelheimers gør det den onden fløjte mig igen. Dette bliver langt fra den traditionelle Orgelheimer-koncert, i det de udelukkende spiller julesange.  Bandet deler julesanghæfter ud, så I kan synge med - om lysten skulle skylle over jer - og de har gaver med til alle i publikum. Alt for mange virkelig dårlige gaver, men bandet håber I tager dem med hjem, og giver dem videre, skulle de vise sig fuldstændig ubrugelige.

Med andre ord:  køb ikke billet til denne koncert, hvis ikke du ønsker at gå hjem med gaver I ikke kan bruge, lettere traumatiserede af dårlig gløgg, brunkager og enormt dårligt performede julesange.

Praktisk info

Fredag den 19. december kl. 20
Billet: 80 kr.
I Bryggekælderen på Njalsgade 15 (indgang via bibliotekets gård).

name: Julebukkens efterfest med Rheum, Valkyra og Kerborinn
description:
Kulturhuset Islands Brygge danner igen i år rammen om Julebukkens efterfest – og du er inviteret!
Aftenen byder på tre stærke musikalske udtryk, der hver især fortolker den nordiske folkemusik på deres egen måde.

Den unge trio Rheum fortolker nordisk folkemusik med en friskhed og musikalitet, der både ærer traditionen og fornyer den. Med et stærkt sammenspil præsenterer de velkendte folkemelodier side om side med egne værker, som alle er arrangeret med nysgerrighed og spilleglæde. Publikum kan se frem til en koncertoplevelse, der kombinerer klangrigdom, rytmisk nærvær og en tydelig kærlighed til folkemusikken.

Valkyra skaber et musikalsk rum, hvor gamle nordiske traditioner flettes sammen med world music, folk-rock og improvisation. Bag Valkyra står musikeren Kathrine Heilesen, der bevæger sig ubesværet mellem harpens bløde klang, strengeinstrumenter, trommer og sjældne folkemusikinstrumenter som sarangi, santoor og hurdy gurdy. Hendes koncertudtryk er både råt og poetisk og trækker på mange musikalske traditioner. Resultatet er et sanseligt lydbillede, som inviterer publikum ind i et grænseløst musikalsk landskab fyldt med atmosfære, rytme og fortællinger.

Kerborinn er et sjællandsk kor- og folkensemble, som arbejder i spændingsfeltet mellem tradition og fornyelse. Musikken tager afsæt i skandinavisk folketone og låner elementer fra barok, impressionisme og andre stilarter, når det understøtter fortællingerne i teksterne. Repertoiret rummer både traditionelle folkesange og originale kompositioner, og lyrikken bevæger sig mellem dansk og oldnordisk. Kerborinn skaber en atmosfærisk, vokalrig koncertoplevelse, hvor stemninger og historier kan udfolde sig.

Uanset om du ankommer direkte fra Julebukkens fakkeloptog i krampus-mundering eller blot iført din vintervarme sweater, inviterer efterfesten til en aften, hvor lys, mørke og fællesskab får lov at folde sig ud gennem musik, dans og sang.

Praktisk info

Julebukkens efterfest
Fredag 20.12 kl. 20.30 i Kulturhuset Islands Brygge
Billet: 60 kr. med forsalg på billetto.dk
Efterfesten er åben for alle

Arrangementet er en del af Julebukken '25

Julebukkens fakkeltog hylder mørkets væsner og lysets tilbagekomst. Vi tager masker på fra folketro og fantasi og går gennem byen, ledt af trommer fra nattens væsner. Optoget begynder i Krigsmuseets Kanongård, hvor stemning og musik sætter scenen, før faklerne tændes og lyset bæres ud i vintermørket. Alle er velkomne – gerne udklædt som buk, bæst eller heks.

Kom og vær med til at vække den gamle jul til live i hjertet af København!

name: ICELANDIC FILM NIGHT: DEVILS ISLAND aka “Djöflaeyjan
description:
We screen Devil’s Island (Djöflaeyjan) from 1996, directed by Friðrik Þór Friðriksson – a gritty, humorous and heartfelt portrayal of life in Reykjavik after World War II. When British and American forces leave their military bunkers behind, the structures become makeshift homes for hundreds of working-class families moving to the capital in search of opportunity.

The film follows these families as they navigate poverty, identity and cultural upheaval, all told with warmth, sharp humour and deep humanity. It offers a vivid snapshot of Icelandic society in the 1950s and the challenges faced by those living on the margins.

The film is screened with English subtitles and is part of Icelandic Film Night, highlighting notable works from Icelandic cinema.

name: It’s a Wonderful Life
description:
We screen Frank Capra’s It’s a Wonderful Life (1946), widely regarded as one of the greatest Christmas films ever made. The film tells the moving story of George Bailey, whose life of generosity and self-sacrifice takes a dramatic turn when he is shown the impact he has had on the people around him. It remains a powerful and emotional tale about community, hope and the meaning we create in each other’s lives.

The screening is presented by CPH Film Club and Huset Biograf as part of CPH Movie Nights – a monthly series showcasing remarkable films from around the world. After the film, you’re invited to the Cinema Café for a relaxed social meetup where you can connect with other film enthusiasts.

name: Tangerine
description:
Tangerine is Sean Baker’s groundbreaking comedy, blending humour, heart and a fast-paced energy in its portrayal of two transgender sex workers, Alexandra and Sin-Dee. Shot on an iPhone 5S using the Filmic Pro app, the film’s raw, dynamic style has earned it a lasting cult status.

The story follows Sin-Dee, newly released after a short time in prison, who on Christmas Eve learns that her boyfriend and pimp Chester has been unfaithful. Together with Alexandra, she sets off on a whirlwind journey through the streets of Los Angeles – a story full of intensity, friendship and humanity.

The film is considered a key work in contemporary American indie cinema and is praised for its respectful and nuanced depiction of transgender experiences.

name: STRANGE WORLD: The Purple Ball
description:
We present The Purple Ball (1988), a Soviet science-fiction classic directed by Pavel Arsenov. The story follows Alisa Seleznyova and her father, Professor Seleznyov, on a space journey where they encounter their friend, archaeologist Gromozeka. His recent discovery is alarming: an entire alien civilization has perished after exposure to a “virus of hostility.” Evidence shows that this virus reached Earth 26,000 years ago – and it is about to break loose.

To prevent disaster, Alisa must travel back in time to an era where witches, dragons and magicians lived alongside ordinary people. The film blends imaginative fantasy with futuristic ideas, creating a unique tale about courage, responsibility and the fragile balance between worlds.

name: GODZILLA AND THE INVASION OF ASTRO-MONSTER
description:
Join us for a screening of Godzilla and the Invasion of Astro-Monster, a hallmark of Japan’s golden age of monster cinema. Directed by Ishiro Honda, the film blends action, science fiction and iconic kaiju characters in a story that has captivated audiences for decades.

The screening is part of our ongoing Asian cinema series, presented in collaboration with the Copenhagen Asian Film Festival. The series highlights key works from Asian film cultures and offers audiences the opportunity to explore both classics and contemporary gems in an engaging cinematic setting.

name: BAD MOVIE CLUB presents The Christmas Special!
description:
Bad Movie Club brings back its beloved Christmas tradition – a night dedicated to wonderfully terrible and wildly entertaining holiday horror films. Expect killer Santas, strange elf creatures and gloriously chaotic splatter movies, all screened on VHS for an authentic retro feel.

Before the main feature, we kick things off with the cult favourite Treevenge, a darkly comedic and over-the-top splatter short that sets the tone for the evening. Throughout the night, you can enjoy glögg and æbleskiver, an essential part of our Christmas celebration.

Programme:
18:30 – Café opens
19:30 – Treevenge + Silent Night Deadly Night Part 2
21:30 – Elves

Tickets are 90 DKK, and legend has it that Santa himself might make an appearance.

name: CHRISTMAS BLOOD X
description:
I år fejrer vi jubilæum: for 10. gang afholder vi Christmas Blood – Fight Racism i Ungdomshuset!


Christmas Blood er et frirum, hvor forskelligheder mødes og bliver til styrke. Et sted, hvor Muay Thai forener mennesker på tværs af grænser, baggrunde og generationer.
I en tid, hvor had og splittelse vokser, insisterer vi på det modsatte: Fællesskab, respekt og solidaritet.


Denne jubilæumsudgave bliver en fejring af mere end 10 år med modstand og sammenhold.
Glæd dig til kampe efter IFMA Muay Thai regler, internationale gyms, DJs, musik og en efterfest, der fortsætter natten ud.


Vi glæder os til at byde jer velkommen til denne særlige Christmas Blood X.
Lad os gøre den til en fantastisk aften, vi aldrig glemmer!


_____________


This year we are celebrating an anniversary: for the 10th time, we are arranging Christmas Blood – Fight Racism in Ungdomshuset. And this years it’s gonna be something speciel!


Christmas Blood is a free space where differences meet and become strength. A place where Muay Thai unites people across borders, backgrounds and generations.
At a time when hatred and division are growing, we insist on the opposite: Community, respect and solidarity.


This anniversary edition will be a celebration of more than 10 years of resistance and unity.
Look forward to fights according to IFMA Muay Thai rules, international gyms, DJs, music and an after-party that will continue into the night.


We look forward to welcoming you to this special Christmas Blood X.
Let make it a fantastic evening we will never forget!


Dør/door: kl.17, kampstart/fights kl.18
Entre: voksne/adults 150 // børn/children: 50

name: Pauli Pocket, SCHAARUP, CERJ
description:
Pauli Pocket is an exceptional talent when it comes to electronic music and is known for her immersive and rhythmically complex sound. Based in Berlin, she became a resident DJ at the infamous Kater Blau in 2015, where she's crafted a unique blend of Indie Dance, Tech House & Techno. 
Her whole journey started back in 2008 in the tender age of 14. At that time Pauli´s gigs were marked by her humble beginnings: carrying vinyl records in a plastic bag, often a written permission of her mum with her, as she was acutally too young to enter the clubs. Pauli Pocket has a strong connection to the city's underground electronic scene. 
By now, she has also made a name for herself far beyond the borders of Berlin and Germany and is now touring the entire world. Her sets are dynamic journeys that captivate listeners, characterized by deep basslines, intricate rhythms, and a hypnotic but forward flow. 
Pauli Pocket's music is both deep and playful, resonating with audiences through its emotional and energetic depth.

name: Artillery + support: Wasted - UDSOLGT - BETA
description:
Døre kl. 19 / show kl. 20
▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄

Artillery slutter et brag af et år af i BETA på Amager. De har turneret i flere lande på bekostning af Danmark, så det råder de hermed bod på.

Artillery blev dannet i Taastrup i 1982 og er et af Danmarks mest markante thrash metal-bands. De tidlige demoer skaffede dem international opmærksomhed, og debutalbummet 'Fear of Tomorrow' blev fulgt op af 'Terror Squad' , der cementerede deres ry i metalmiljøet. Efter 'By Inheritance' i 1990 opløstes bandet midlertidigt, men gendannedes i slut-90’erne.

Artillery har siden udgivet en række anmelderroste albums og turneret verden over. Trods flere udskiftninger i besætningen har de bevaret en aggressiv, teknisk stil, der blander hurtige riffs med melodiske elementer, og de regnes i dag som pionerer inden for europæisk thrash metal.

___

Wasted blev dannet i København i 1981 og var en del af den tidlige danske heavy metal-scene. Bandet udgav debutalbummet *Black Death* i 1984, som kombinerede klassisk metal med rå energi. Efter flere pauser er Wasted vendt tilbage med ny musik og koncerter, stadig tro mod deres oldschool metalrødder.

name: Improv Made You a Mixtape
description:
Rewind to your dearest, weirdest or most fabulous music memory and loop us in on why a certain song or album is so special to you.

As the Rockstar that you are, expect to be interviewed about your song or album choice. We will take anything and everything as inspiration: From songs you dance to with your sweetheart to the track you lost your virginity to. From that one track that pushes you to do the extra burpee to a weepy breakup anthem. From your current on-repeat hit to that tune you play when you miss home.

The possibilities are endless!

Next, sit back and watch us untangle the lyrics, the vibe and the stories of your treasured tunes as we press play on an entirely improvised show based on your song or album suggestion.

Frequencies are expected to range from AM(azing) to FM (fu&#ing memorable, duh).

Fast forward to after the show, when your cheeks hurt from laughing and all of your song suggestions are bundled up into a mixtape, we made especially for you.

From France, JAST, one of the most promising upcoming artists on the melodic scene, bringing his rich, emotional soundscapes to Copenhagen.

Alongside them, Baime returns to the home floor, delivering his signature high-energy, melodic techno, and Davide Bonventre joins with his atmospheric and powerful touch — a perfect balance of groove and intensity.

Meanwhile, in the Kiosk, the BLASFÉMIA Collective takes over once again, with SPACER and MIKLEI representing Slovakia and Ukraine. Expect fast-paced rhythms, raw underground energy, and nonstop motion in our little hotbox.

AETHR keeps evolving. The energy stays real. 🌑

name: Heels workshop i Absalon
description:
Har du også længe ledt efter en god grund til at hoppe i de der flotte høje hæle, du har haft stående hjemme i skabet, men aldrig har haft anledning til at bruge? Så er det nu du skal hive dem frem fra gemmerne og tage dem med til heels-workshop.

Heels er en workshop for ALLE uanset køn, alder, niveau osv. Måske har du danset før, måske er det helt nyt for dig - doesn’t matter. Så længe du har lyst til at prøve at danse i høje hæle, er du velkommen.

Vi vil arbejde med blandt andet balance, elegance, attitude, hvordan man går i høje hæle og vi afslutter med en lille heels koreografi, der vil få vores indre diva til at shine. 

Vi danser til en blanding af musik fra ikoniske hits til nye tracks, der har det til fælles at de fejrer empowerment og selvtillid. So show up and let’s keep our heads and heels high together!


Om underviseren:
Mie har taget to danseuddannelser i klassiske og undergrundsstilarter på Sceneindgangen og Hotstepper. Nu lever hun af at undervise, optræde og koreografere. Hun er en energibombe, der spreder glæde med sin højlydte latter, og hun går op i at skabe et trygt rum sammen med sine elever, hvor alle kan føle sig velkomne og ikke mindst have en fest! 


Vi glæder os til at danse med jer!

Kh Mie Bjarnild og Absalon

 
****PRAKTISK INFO****

Pris: 100 kr. 
Køb billet her: https://absaloncph.dk/event/heels-workshop/

Medbring selv hæle til indedørs brug - det kan både være brede hæle og stiletter. Vær opmærksom på, at hvis du danser i stiletter, skal hælen være af plastik/gummi. Er den af metal, skal den beskyttes med et plastik/gummi-cover.

Class will be taught in English if needed

name: Burlesque workshop i Absalon
description:
Er du vild med film som ‘Burlesque’, ‘Moulin Rouge’ og ‘Chicago’ - og har du lyst til selv at kaste dig ud i showdans, glitter og glam?

Så tag med til burlesque danseworkshop med Mie. En festlig dansetime med humor, sensualitet og leg med feminine udtryk i dansen. Burlesque går ud på at forbløffe, forføre og fascinere, og holdet for alle køn, aldre og niveauer osv.

Om underviseren
Mie har to danseuddannelser i klassiske og undergrundsstilarter fra Sceneindgangen og Hotstepper. Nu lever hun af at undervise, optræde og koreografere. 

Vi glæder os til at danse med jer!
Kh Mie Bjarnild og Absalon

 
****PRAKTISK INFO****

Pris: 75 kr. 
Køb billet her: https://absaloncph.dk/begivenhed/burlesque-dance-workshop/

Kom i glimmer, fjer, boa, korset, knæstrømper, festtøj.. eller træningstøj! Du bestemmer. Hvis du vil danse med sko på, så husk et par dansesko. I Klubben danser vi kun i indesko eller på bare tæer /strømpesokker.

The class will be in English if needed.
